_doc: Event-category registry for the PLANNED news-event impact model (equities). Added 2026-11-01 (Tho t39u, INTC lesson). SPEC/LABELS ONLY - nothing reads this into signals, forecasts or weights yet. Crypto event categories stay owned by portfolio_engine/crypto_events.py (Binance-hack watch routine runs to 2026-11-07); this file does NOT change that module or its thresholds. When the impact model is built (after 2026-11-07), any scoring use must pass ops/backtest_gate.py.

earnings_guidance_shock.label_th: งบ/แนวโน้มรายได้ช็อก (earnings / guidance)
earnings_guidance_shock.scope: single stocks + sector read-through (peers, sector ETF, index)
earnings_guidance_shock.structured_trigger: company-published earnings reaction session (earnings_risk.reaction_day) with |reaction-day move| >= 7% or |z| >= 3 vs trailing 60d vol

known_facts.band_rule_live: forecast bands x2.156 (3d) / x1.204 (1m) when an earnings reaction day is inside the horizon - ops/earnings_band_gate.py PASS 2026-11-01
known_facts.post_gap_drift: basket of 12 US mega/large caps, 5y: median next-20d after a <= -7% earnings gap = -0.16%, lower in 50% of cases -> no reliable drift edge (descriptive)
known_facts.post_gap_block_rule: gate PASS but decided by ONE rebalance in 7y (GOOGL Jul 2026) -> SHADOW (data/shadow/earnings_post_gap_shadow.jsonl)
